From the moment I experienced the demo of NIMRODS: GunCraft Survivor, I was captivated by its exhilarating world. Diving headfirst into its vibrant landscapes, I've been an ardent fan ever since. Now, after countless hours with the full version, I can confidently say that the game has evolved tremendously. It has transformed into something spectacular, offering players richer gameplay, exciting expansions, and an innovative concept that's both addictive and groundbreaking. Gameplay The thrill of immersing myself in intense combat scenarios while crafting a variety of weapons showcases the game's ingenious mechanics. There's an undeniable rush that comes from strategizing, engaging in epic battles, and narrowly escaping danger. The sheer variety of enemies keeps each encounter fresh and exciting, creating a dynamic challenge that keeps the adrenaline pumping. New Content The game introduces a wealth of new content that's a treasure trove of surprises, adding layers to the gameplay experience. Navigating this new terrain has been thrilling, as each discovery enhances the depth and enjoyment of the game. The plethora of features and upgrades ensures that players are constantly engaged and eager to explore more. Boss Mechanics One of the most intriguing aspects of the game lies in its boss mechanics. The Boss Hit Zone adds a unique twist to the gameplay, requiring players to adapt their strategies and stay on their toes. This innovative approach to boss battles adds an extra layer of excitement and challenge, making each victory all the more satisfying. Conclusion My experience with NIMRODS: GunCraft Survivor has reignited my passion for gaming. I'm filled with enthusiasm for the exciting journey this game offers and the challenges that accompany it. I wholeheartedly recommend it to fellow gamers—prepare yourself for an exhilarating adventure that demands skill and persistence. So grab your weapons, gather your courage, and dive into this mesmerizing gun-slinging escapade!

Edit: After spending more time with the game and after the recent update, the game still sucks, it still isn't fun, and the dev has stopped responding to me and anyone else criticizing the game at all. Avoid this one. This isn't fun. Other bullet hell games get easier the more you play and with more successive runs. This game gets HARDER from the base level and the upgrades that you buy for your guns become more and more random as you unlock more and more of them. It's like you already have a bag of dice but then with each new modification to your weapon you unlock, you add another die to that bag, and then another and another and another. Eventually it gets to a point where you might NEVER see the one mod unlock you bought that you thought would help you get further in the next run....EVER. While it is true that you can save your gun from each run, that doesn't mean that each gun from every run is worth saving at all because of what I've just mentioned above. Every run is RNG on top of RNG and it does not get easier. This then means that unless you're able to dodge pretty much everything and are super competent at these kinds of games, you will die very quickly, you will not advance all that much, and you will wind up in a loop of barely progressing at all while continually buying gun modifications that make your pool of pulls even deeper and your run even more RNG and even harder. The furthest I ever got out of something like twenty odd runs was one mini boss and that's it before dying again and again and again. Other games in this genre at least have a form of newbie protection built in that let you build up power and eventually progress over time. This game does not. While the dopamine hits of leveling up may feel fun, you're ultimately going to wind up banging your head against the same brick wall over and over again unless you're really good at these games. It's a nice idea in theory but I'm surprised that no one realized this sooner and at least gave a higher chance at rolling newer and better upgrades than the basic ones you get at the start. Some of the early parts of the game also require a bit more explanation as to just where stuff is and what unlocks behind certain doors. Why would I bother trying to kill certain bosses if I don't even know what I get from doing so and if I can't even get there to begin with? Additionally, there doesn't seem to be any ability to edit your game save files. And given what I've just described about how hard this game is, it will attract a certain kind of player, and you all know what that does to the community. I'm not sure if this is worth a "Wait and See" stance...there are some ways to ameliorate some of these problems but that all depends on what future changes the devs implement.

Cool idea, neat look and feel.....but it has that 1 ♥♥♥♥♥♥ designing it creating cool things and then adding anti fun elements to turn those things into a massive, unfun grind. At the end of the day, this game is extremely confused as to what its trying to be - ending up in a mishmash of poorly implemented idea. The fundamental gameplay flow is constantly interrupted by burdensome mechanics. Taking Vampire Survivors as an example, you can turn your brain off and zone into the game. This? No. Interruptions every minute or two - Whether its an XP tower, chest, collection/defend zone, boss fight introduction, enemies just showing up already encircling you...it all adds up to constant interruptions. Immediate or quickly available meta progression? Fun No meta progression at the start? Anti Fun (No, garbage gun upgrades don't count) Rerolls, bans, swaps, and etc when getting upgrades? Fun Not having them at all and bricking your run if you get a bad selection? Anti fun and stupid. Having a health bar? Cool, Fun Having NO ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ HEALTH REGEN? Anti Fun And no, the .04 you might be able to get 13 minutes in? That doesn't count. Gaining max health not healing you for that health gain? Stupid. Even the healing items are pathetically weak. XP collection orb to grab missed XP? Fun Locking that orb behind a tough tower that shoots large bullets that hit for a massive chunk of your health? Anti fun and outright retarded. Unlocking meta progression elements and parts of the ship? Fun Locking the entire meta progression behind expensive purchases and killing the 3rd boss? Anti fun and retarded. It shouldn't take me 5 to 6 runs to get to purchase meta progression.....then another 10+ just to get a couple of upgrades. Bee Hive that spawns bees when you hit it? Fun Bee Hive that DOESN'T STOP spawning a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of bees when you it it? Anti-Fun and retarded. I didn't make it past that before uninstalling. Maybe will pick it up again after some updates, but right now I'm not convinced the devs know wtf a fun bullet hell game is. Just buy Vampire Survivors or Halls of Torment - much better games without the Autistic developers who think 36 health regenerated in 30 minutes is a good idea.

The grind in this game is insane. The very pricey unlocks dont make you feel powerful at all, and TBH I'm not even sure I have gotten them in a run. Meta progression is awful, how am I supposed to defeat a boss if my new unlocks don't show up? At certain points the game feels more like a bullet hell game because so many ranged enemies spawn. The main problem in this game is the meta progression, you never feel stronger. For example I have unlocked skills for my drone but cant access them because I havent survived long enough to encounter it. Wheres the logic behind this?

你好作者, 我是一个从试玩版就开始玩的玩家, 虽然现在吸血鬼的游戏众多,但是我觉得你这款游戏还是挺有新意的,虽然难度稍高,肝度非常高,!!! 优点和缺点都有我就不多啰嗦了 ,我只想说以下几点建议 1: 建议做一个单个未解锁蓝图的追踪功能,让未解锁的蓝图能在小地图上显示位置(因为我还剩下2个蓝图未解锁,但是我已经花了10多局的时间一个一个区域的去找蓝图,但是还未找到,我相信会有很多人遇到这个问题) 2:建议局外增加一个拾取范围的成长,并且局内成长的拾取范围的数值也要调整一下(数值太低了),又或者你把全图吸经验的绿光调整为也能吸材料,不然材料真的刷的太痛苦了,几乎要走的很近才能拾取到材料!!! 3:枪械除了实弹枪,别的枪可以重做或者大幅调整了. 因为除开实弹枪别的枪就像出来搞笑的,枪和枪之间的差距很大! 4:大部分的配件也能调整了,因为有些配件真的太鸡肋了,数值差就算了,专属功能性也差,不调整每个部位的配件用来用去其实就那一个.(其实你可以做个配件套装系统,例如配件A+配件B=额外C效果) 5:优化很差 后期卡顿掉帧 我都不敢相信一个这么小的游戏 玩的我显卡的风扇嗷嗷的叫 6:你想你的游戏能火,中国一定是一个很重要的市场, 虽然现在的中文比之前的好, 但是还是机翻的味道, 很多配件功能的中文表达因为是机翻 ,完全看不懂准确的配件功能是什么样的, 建议中文再优化一下. 暂时就这么多了 习惯性的好评, 希望作者能参考一下建议. 谢谢!

A million ways to make a gun, but only a small handful work. Each body is different, slow rocket launcher with big explosions vs. fast assault rifle and more. That's cool. Each barrel or clip mod is different, adding splitting shots or explosive rounds. That's cool too. The problem is that many combinations are just awful. The explosive rounds clip is pointless for a rocket launcher but still lowers its already slow rate of fire. The sniper barrel on the assault rifle guarantees a horde with kill you since you won't have enough area coverage. Nimrods is far more difficult than other bullet heaven games, so if you want to survive past the first few minutes you have to pick combinations that work together. The game tells you to be creative but will swiftly kill you if you stray from the best options. Assuming you are even allowed to pick those best options. Each level gives a choice of only three items and you might not even see the parts you want. In order to progress, I end up repeatedly restarting runs until I get the good picks. What's the point of being creative if the third boss will slaughter any sub-par build?

Nimrods is a promising addition to the bullet heaven genre that is held back by unfortunate design choices. The gunplay is fun and strikes the itch and satisfaction of similar titles in the genre. It has a diverse meta progression system with many things to work and grind towards and plenty of reason to do "just 1 more run". The game could be so much better but it does things that just don't make sense and make it annoying to play. Health regeneration is essentially non existent even if you upgrade the meta progression for it. There's no way to banish an augment from the level up screen and there's no way to decline the upgrade, some of the upgrades are so bad that the cons far outweigh the pros and it forces you to take them. I'll get a level up in game with only 1 augment option and it can completely brick your build because you can't decline. I was trying to unlock all weapon attachments and now there are some that I can't disable that are circulating in my upgrade pool and it's a risk to just play a match because most likely they'll pop up and brick whatever build i'm going for. The level up system itself is unnecessarily complicated. Instead of just showing a level up screen when you max the xp bar and letting you choose, it drops a drop pod that you have to collect to than trigger your level up screen. More often than not when this happens, you're forced to double back to go grab it because you're actively traveling around the map to collect materials and unlock more areas. Just complicated for no reason other than to be annoying. The bosses, while the designs are cool, the boss fight themselves are tedious and boring. They have 1 move and the fight just consists of run away and shoot because they are just complete bullet sponges. Some of the poorest boss design I can recall in recent memory. They're not hard, you fight them once and think "that was cool" and every time after that they're a chore to deal with. I really want to like this game, when it works and you get a build rolling its a blast to play, but more often than not I find myself frustrated with it. I won't write it off completely because it is an early access title and things are subject to change, and I think they have a solid starting point here for something truly great. I'll continue to follow updates on the game and will update my review accordingly if and when it improves.
怎么会有这么恶心的开发者，各种资源给的贼少，打完一把金币就五千多，各种图纸还有地图探索也费劲，玩到后面模式非常单一，而且永远那几个选项，垃圾游戏，完全不推荐

只能说凑凑合合吧，主角的性能很难说到位，只能说有点弱，并且养成的路线非常非常非常长，并且非常非常非常难；常规来说道具要解锁，但是吧解锁不仅仅是达成某项条件或者使用资源就可以解锁的，有一部分是需要找到地图上的蓝图点位完成占点才能获取到；说到要在地图找点位，这地图非常非常非常非常非常大，在游戏默认给的摄像机高度下，如果不是对地图有高度敏感度，或者遗忘了游戏中地图是可以拖动的话，可能玩了几个小时还在初始区域转悠。 然后就是这游戏我觉得应该算是原罪的养成，就是提升主角性能的养成，那叫一个又贵又难又臭又长，首先关乎主角性能的就需要解锁仨建筑，这仨建筑动辄大几万到十万的，捏嘛一把胡点打完最后的boss，也就带个五六千出来，牛魔的真不把玩家时间当时间啊；假设你只完成了便宜的那俩的解锁，那么你只能获得一个不完整并且差不多图一乐的提升，这里就类似于传奇里的镶嵌系统，其中一个建筑通过给资源去获取镶嵌用的属性道具，并且属性道具也是需要解锁的，并不是你解锁建筑就全给你买；到这还没完，当你兴高采烈的购买完镶嵌道具，想去镶嵌的时候，你就发现，牛魔主角默认技能下的槽位怎么这么少？诶这你就问到位了，主角的可镶嵌槽位还是要解锁的呢，那么怎么解锁呢？进图玩，累计经验解锁，开不开心？当你框框猛奴之后发现，这默认技能虽然有很多槽位，但是实际可以解锁的只有其中的一部分，剩下的部分我仍未知道要怎么解锁。 然后有人问了，你刚刚说默认技能，那其他技能呢？诶，这就是下一个粪坑了，这游戏每个主角的每个技能的镶嵌槽位都是单独的经验解锁的，你需要带着对应技能进去游玩累计经验才能解锁槽位，而且每个技能的槽位组合都是不同的，这游戏就是实打实的没活硬整，硬拖游玩时长，纯屎，不叮叮是真玩不了。 然后的然后，刚刚说到你只解锁俩建筑的情况，这第三个最几把贵最几把粪的建筑来了，不仅解锁昂贵，而且他只干一件事，升级你的镶嵌物，从最低级到最高级，消耗的道具也从最低级到最高级，素材的消耗量非常非常非常惊人，说实话，我给所有素材都刷了9999，您猜怎么着，还没升级完所有镶嵌物，第二还是第三个材料率先消失，也就是说这徽章升级能回收你上百小时的素材，很难想象有谁在这游戏上搁这硬刷这玩楞，我是不乐意奉陪。 剩下的解锁项目是落下来的舱可以部分替换成其他解锁项目以及无人机跟随的模式和一点点便利内容，舱的解锁项目我暂时未知是蓝图还是来自成就，这个我没有细看，打着打着就解锁了。然后逆天的来了，升级这个舱可以增加可用数和内容数，但是升级也是要巨量金币和一些素材的，基本上升级两种舱到最高级，要消耗二十万左右的金币，我看不懂，我大受震撼。 虽然我给好评，但是我不推荐购买，成长不够线性，中后期游戏内容疲软无力，除非你乐意和我一样开个叮叮，刷刷这游戏乐一乐，那还算勉强能玩，就这样。

Tldr - A rare breath of fresh air amidst survivor games with its own creative vison, and it already has a decent amount of content for an early access release. The devs are also putting consistent efforts introducing things and ironing the game out, so it's a welcome standout above the sea of uninspired and bland survivor games. In a bit more detail - the game's an interesting take on the genre that most notably introduces a huge persistent map with various biomes, each with its own inhabitant creatures that try to swarm and unalive you, and you can smoothly transition from one biome to another as you explore. The gameplay and style are probably the closest in comparison to "20 Minutes Til Dawn", except it's a sci-fi setting in space that stands nicely on its own. Some highlights at the time of writing: - befitting the name, player builds are tied to gun customization each run with an already pretty decent pool of mix-and-match options - a drone companion that you can equip with any one gun you've used in previous runs - persistent open world you progressively explore with varying biomes (and inhabitant creatures) - exploration elements for finding blueprints and resources to broaden meta options, sometimes with light puzzles or tasks to vary up the loop of surviving hordes - a rare case of the game having a clear identity and style that goes smoothly together with mechanics - an active dev team that cares about expanding the game, discord server included Deffo worth trying if you're into the genre. Just know that some elements may be vague and not yet explained in the game, so its worth orienting yourself as you go, especially with the stations in the main hub (since some lead to unlocking rerolls/banishes, and the meta gene allocation is a bit more complex than just "buy and forget".)

In my opinion, this game has no potential, because its design is based on contradictions. Guns cannot guarantee your survival, even if you force a drone to provide a second weapon. The rack unlocking is full of restrictions, and the interval between orders makes survival even more difficult. Under this kind of survival pressure, players do not have a good game experience at all. After a period of time, the game feedback dropped to the freezing point. It is a very bad design. The map is also designed so badly that some narrow terrains make people have no desire to pass. I understand that you want to combine Risk of Rain 2 and Survivor, but the combination is so bad, and the character 3C is even worse. I tried my best to find fun places, but there were too many negative feedbacks. Every time I was about to make a breakthrough, I was always surrounded by a bunch of monsters and died inexplicably. In short, it is a very bad game. There are some ideas, but not many.

在传统幸存者游戏里加了个无人机的机制，可以把自己带出来的武器给无人机，相当于可以带两把枪战斗（但是技能加成无法带出），其他的全是糟粕，如果时间很多很无聊的话打折时可以买来玩玩，不然完全不推荐。 1、游戏的内容贫瘠，人物只有2个，地图只有1张，为了拖游戏时长就出现了被评论区各种差评点名的局外成长机制：绝大部分武器装备完成五花八门纯拖时间的任务解锁和购买（包括但不限于把前置升满的配件枪带回来卖掉一次、用xx技能或武器杀四位数的敌人、在巨大无指引的固定地图里找蓝图等等），解锁了之后还要花钱和特殊资源买才能用，还没完，配件从第2层升级开始又开始卡你新的解锁条件了，后期升级的全都需要通关一次才能领一个的材料，装备不够就打不过关卡boss，打不过关卡boss就提升不了装备，秀儿。另外配件之间也没有满级组合增强的机制。 2、人物走路慢，捡经验范围小，技能cd长到匪夷所思。30秒cd的2秒加速移动，30秒cd做一次翻滚……这种水平的被动技能只能选一个，这体能就别幸存了，赶紧死外星球吧。boss和小精英不知道做完了有没有自己测试过攻击强度和移动速度，那个长的像labubu的独眼怪经常一次刷一圈，然后十几个长条攻击范围啪一下铺出半个屏幕大小的正圆形，我知道一个长条很长我可以横着躲开，那么请问这么大个圆形的范围走路跟蜗牛一样慢的玩家该怎么躲呢？侥幸活下来了，来个大长腿boss，跑过来直接全程贴在你身上，甩都甩不掉，被碰撞伤害活活耗死，请问又要怎么玩呢？ 3、再谈解锁机制，有个狙击枪武器，解锁要求大概是一局达到80%以上命中，我不知道游戏要求的命中率具体是怎么样的计算规则，反正玩了好多局后期一枪N发子弹的武器都达不到要求的命中率，不知道什么样的超人类会纯手点玩这种满屏都是怪的游戏。 4、游戏基本的操作体验也差，自动攻击状态下强制隐藏鼠标，偏偏又有很多需要手动释放的下挂配件技能。我鼠标都看不见在哪，右键一点瞄准的机会都不给就扔出去了，6点刮痧伤害的手雷啪叽一下扔空地上，真好。 5、最搞笑的是符文插槽机制：只需要击杀万八千个敌人，就可以解锁整整2个槽位了。然后是槽的含金量：+6点HP的符文，只需要插5个插槽就可以获得30点最大血量了，升级符文后期需要的都是每次通关只能领到一个的材料，不知道什么样的热爱能让玩家把这唯一的一张游戏地图打个百八十局，最后只为了那一点点提升。

--I really wanted to unlock all content before leaving a review, but this game is currently so half-baked it is a frustration to play more than anything. If I was the dev, I would focus on making more builds and weapons viable. At the time of writing this, and the first time I played it, when there was a lot less content, the default assault rifle is the god of all weapons. It can get hits at any range, adapt to any build, has the best damage, reload and magazine size. --I find this very sad because the game in theory has a lot of possible combinations. However, trying to build, let's say, around the sniper rifle barrel is suicide as of writing this. The enemies swarm you from all sides and are sometimes faster than you even without the sniper barrel slow. This means it's a useless part of the game. Again, at this time. It would need either to slow you less, or compensate for this flaw better via dmg, bullet spread, and penetrations. --The RPG fires tiny little sniper bullets that explode after 3m. This does not really evoke what an RPG irl is, but also it's not good for the gameplay. Using it feels terrible. It shoots slow, it shoots tiny bullets, that do little damage. The default assault rifle is incredibly more powerful, which is like... We're talking about an RPG, right? How can the assault rifle so easily outmatch it? And why? I don't mind the low clip and slow reload time, but where is the impact of the weapon? I would increase bullet size and damage to try and bring it closer to assault rifle level of power. --The shotgun is laughably underpowered. On paper it does 40ish dmg level 1, if iirc, but paper doesn't matter vs in-game experience of using the weapon. The blast should be satisfying, not a whimper in the dark. Reload speed being incredibly slow only exacerbates this. I've tried to amp up dmg while reducing reload speed and it just doesn't match... you guessed it, the basic pistol and AR. --This is all at level 1 btw, before augments are added, at which point again, the assault rifle is superior to all other weapons. It outpaces them, because it tends to scale better with upgrades. I would also invest into better shooting sfx. It is the primary sound of a game like this, and all of them sound cheap, grating, and unsatisfying. tl;dr Fun concept, but undercooked. Keep cooking tho, dev. You got smthn on your hands.

After 50+ hours of pointless grinding, having all genes and gunparts unlocked and having gotten all but two of the achievements, I feel I have spent enough time with the game to be able to give a decent review of it. Pros: Fun build crafting, easy to understand UI, enjoyable map/game/enemy designs Cons: Builds are limited heavily by rng, to the point of restarting runs because the gun part you wanted did not roll. Enemies are well designed but become very repetitive after a few runs. This is a game I really wanted to like but the balance design is absolutely horrid and I would not recommend picking the game up in its current state.. It feels like runs are borderline unsurvivable by the 20 minute mark and that the only way to gain power is from genes which are both a pain to unlock and a nightmare to grind. Most of the game's weapon "upgrades" often have a drawback which makes them borderline unusable in a run, like heavily neutering your fire rate, absurdly long reload speeds, reducing bullet damage to the point where your bullets are practically tickling your foes, reducing your attack range to borderline melee status (basically what Containment Field does), slowing you down to the point where you cannot kite bosses (meaning your run is over by the time Big Carl spawns), etc. One of my biggest gripes with Nimrods though is just how stingy the developers are with health regeneration, whether it's the absurdly low spawn rates of apples and medkits, health regeneration upgrades which heal a tiny percentage of your health bar each minute, or the very few weapon mods that actually give some form of lifesteal. And the two augments I've found so far that grant this have major drawbacks. Vampiric Magazine for example not only heals an absurdly small amount on kill, but is also sadistically tied to a previous upgrade (Hemolytic Magazine) that saps your health when dealing bullet damage whilst above 50% HP. So not only are you healing for 0.05 Health per kill, but you've also effectively sliced your health pool in half by picking it up. Another one is Piercing Ammo, which restores 0.003 Health for every enemy penetrated by your bullets, except for the first and last penetration, which not only makes the effect useless if your Penetration stat is lower than 3, but also heals such an absurdly low amount, that it would take well over 33.3k penetrations to heal 100 Health, or the base max HP your character starts with. The process of unlocking genes is tedious in itself, as many of them are located in zones you practically can't survive without very specific gun/augment builds. But then you have to grind thousands of honeycombs and monster eyes to upgrade them...

There are a lot of mixed comments from the community regarding the difficulty of the game, but I think that they may be misaligned. I actually found the game to be incredibly easy in regard to unlocking mechanics and beating each run-through, but at the same time this is only because the game is incredibly new, not flushed out all the way, and there are A LOT of balancing issues. For example, there are two types of builds that can be taken that will blow this game out of the park (will let you figure it out), while there are another 5-8 that simply don't have anywhere near the impact that one would hope. Even so, the pros are incredibly strong despite the number of cons and limitations. Pros: - The large map gives a fun explorative feel to a genre that is generally quite linear amongst games. - There progression system feels fluid and unique with a lot of pre-run tools to customize. - The ways in which you build for each run can be fun (though again it's imbalanced right now). - The mechanics for leveling is unique in regard to how levels are achieved. - There are hidden secrets in the game. Cons: - (Not really a fair con) The game is in early development so there is a lot of content that needs to be expanded on in order to make the game feel complete when it comes to builds. - Game is not balanced for what builds are available (elemental builds and ability builds need major improvement). - The single map is good, but more maps with more biomes would make the game more unique, challenging, and allow for better replayability. - Bosses are overly straightforward, easy to understand, and you can pretty much avoid all damage against them relatively easily. - The resource mechanic is a little stingy with progression requiring resources but resources being difficult to accumulate in comparison to how different mechanics are quickly unlocked. Overall Verdict: Get it if you are bored and wanting to kill some time. If not, give the game some times and purchase when it's more flushed out.

I've found this game to be a pleasant mix between challenging and fun. I enjoy modding my gun each run and exploring the potentials hidden in all the add ons. Your first few runs will take a while figuring out the mechanics of the weapons and upgrading, but overall it is relatively basic if you've ever played any game like this. Damage, rate of fire, reload speed, crit chance/damage, move speed, all the usual business. It does take a bit of time to farm at the start, but the hand full of runs where you are figuring out what to do just save your money. Don't feel compelled to buy everything immediately or every gun in order just because you have the money. I purchased up to the SMG and then saved up until I had enough to buy the best (most expensive) gun that was offered without having to find the chassis on the map. Having that gun I was able to then explore relatively easily for new chassis, mods, and upgrades, as well as gather resources much more efficiently. None of this took dozens of hours like some games where you spend 30hrs just grinding to get somewhere. I have put in just over 16hrs at this point and I have explored most of the map and I assume it won't take me too much longer to finish exploring. Now I am just curious if this game will ever get out of EA, because i looked at purchasing it 10 times over the last year and change before I finally decided to recently, and it is still in EA. Either way good fun and I recommend if you like pew pew pewing like a madman.
